references.name: reference/view1-oblique
references.shows: The whole Hush Garden from high in the south-west: the hedge maze in four coloured quarters, the watchtower in the middle, the gate tower on the east edge, the meadow beyond.

references.name: reference/view2-plan
references.shows: The garden straight down: the maze's quarters, the heart with the tower, the sundial court, the old well, the bells and the gate tower.

references.name: reference/view3-lane
references.shows: Eye height in a green lane: hedge-capped walls above the eye, a bell at the junction, the watchtower over the wall tops.

references.name: concept/heart-near
references.shows: The heart court at eye height: the watchtower's foot with its arched door and ladder, the bench with the gardener's note, two lanterns.

references.name: concept/heart-far
references.shows: The heart from about thirty blocks up: the court in the middle of the four quarters, the watchtower's deck and copper roof above the walls.

references.name: concept/deck-near
references.shows: The lookout deck at eye height: the rail, the lectern of four bell buttons under signs in the quarters' colours, the maze below and the gate tower on its far edge.

references.name: concept/sundial-near
references.shows: The sundial court in the rose quarter with the crank handle hung on the sundial.

references.name: concept/sundial-far
references.shows: The sundial court from above the rose quarter, the watchtower and the gate tower beyond.

references.name: concept/well-near
references.shows: The old well in the green quarter's far corner, sculk round it, the warden digging up out of the ground.

references.name: concept/well-far
references.shows: The green quarter's corner from above: the dark stain round the well and the warden in the cheerful maze.

references.name: concept/lane-near
references.shows: A yellow lane: the runner creeping along the wall, a slime behind, the warden at the next junction, a bell beyond.

references.name: concept/lane-far
references.shows: The east quarters from above: a player and the warden two turns apart, a bell between them.

references.name: concept/gate-near
references.shows: The gate tower's hall: the winch with the crank fitted, the inside of the great gate on its chains, the ladder up.

references.name: concept/gate-far
references.shows: The east side from above: the great gate open onto the meadow and the plank bridge across the maze from the gate tower's top to the watchtower.

references.name: concept/meadow-near
references.shows: The meadow outside the open gate: the gardener waving in her apron and straw hat.

references.name: concept/meadow-far
references.shows: The meadow from above in low gold light, the gate tower and the maze beside it, the gardener in the middle.
